content.short: Solana Compass offers detailed analytics of Solana's performance, fees, and decentralization.
content.description: Solana Compass clarifies the Solana ecosystem with analytics, guides, and tools designed to demystify how it works. It covers fee tracking, decentralization dashboards, and TPS performance charts, alongside tokenomics, compute metrics, and stake-change metrics. The platform offers various guides and utilities, including an app that helps stakers move and merge stakes or monitor returns for tax purposes, plus an index of the top validators. All tools are free, supported by revenue from the Solana Compass validator.
content.meta: Solana Compass provides detailed analytics, guides, and tools to explain the Solana ecosystem. Discover Solana Compass and other Web3 apps on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
